item.title: Installation
item.description:
Before You Begin

Package Contents

Verify you have received all components:

  • Haltian Gateway XS unit
  • 12V DC power supply
  • Cellular antenna (SMA connector)
  • 2.4 GHz radio antenna (SMA connector)
  • Mounting accessories (TBD)

Additional Requirements

You will need:

  • Power outlet: Standard AC outlet appropriate for your region
  • Network access: Cellular coverage at the installation site
  • Tools: Screwdriver for mounting (if required)

Pre-Configured Connectivity

Cellular connectivity and SIM card are configured by Haltian before delivery. The gateway connects to the cellular network automatically after power-on — no SIM installation or network configuration is required by the customer.

item.title: Configuration
item.description:
Overview

The Gateway XS is designed for minimal customer configuration. Cellular connectivity is pre-configured by Haltian before delivery, and no customer network configuration is required for the standard deployment.

Cellular Connectivity

The LTE cellular connection is fully managed by Haltian:

  • SIM card: Pre-installed and configured — no customer action required
  • Network registration: Automatic on power-on
  • APN settings: Pre-configured
  • Connection management: Handled by gateway firmware
Note

If you need to deploy the gateway in a location with specific network restrictions or requirements, contact Haltian support before installation.

item.title: Operation
item.description:
Normal Operation

Startup Sequence

Gateway boot process takes approximately 60–90 seconds:

  1. Power On (0-5 seconds)

    • Hardware initialization
    • Self-test procedures

  2. Network Initialization (5-30 seconds)

    • Network interfaces activate
    • Cellular registration

  3. Cloud Connection (30-60 seconds)

    • TLS connection establishment
    • Authentication and registration
    • NTP synchronization

  4. Wirepas Mesh Start (60-90 seconds)

    • 2.4 GHz radio initialization
    • Network scanning
    • Sink role activation
Note

The Gateway XS does not have user-visible status LEDs. Monitor operational state through Haltian Studio.

item.title: Specifications
item.description:
Hardware

Component Specification
Main CPU NXP i.MX9352
Architecture ARM Cortex-A55, dual-core
Clock speed 1.7 GHz
RAM 1 GB
Storage 16 GB internal
Operating system Embedded Linux (Debian-based)

Connectivity

Feature Specification
Ethernet interface RJ45
Ethernet availability Physical port reserved for planned customer-specific LAN access; not part of the standard deployment
Cellular technology LTE Cat1bis
Cellular module SIMCOM SIM7672
SIM Pre-installed and configured by Haltian
Antenna connectors External, SMA connector
Customer setup No customer network configuration required
Short-range radio Nordic nRF52840, 2.4 GHz ISM band
Protocol support Wirepas Mesh, installed by default; Gateway XS operates as a mesh sink

Security

Feature Specification
Hardware security NXP EdgeLock Secure Enclave + Arm OP-TEE
Boot Secure boot with signed firmware
Communication security Encrypted (TLS) to backend services
Firmware signing Haltian secure firmware layer

Electrical and Physical

Parameter Specification
Input voltage 12V DC
Power supply External adapter (included)
Connector DC barrel jack
Antenna connectors 2x SMA (cellular + 2.4 GHz)
Mounting Wall mount bracket supported

Environmental

Parameter Specification
Operating temperature 0°C to +60°C
Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C
Humidity 5% to 95% non-condensing
IP rating IP20 (indoor use only)

Regulatory and Conformity Information

Item Value
Manufacturer Haltian Oy
Product name Haltian Gateway XS
Model / product code TGWXS
Intended use Fixed indoor gateway for secure cellular connectivity and local device management
Applicable directives RED 2014/53/EU, EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU
Standards EN 301 489-1, EN 301 489-17, EN 301 489-52, EN 55032, EN 55035, EN IEC 61000-6-2, EN IEC 61000-6-3
Regional approvals CE, UKCA, FCC, ICES, KC, VCCI, RCM
Test report CTHEMC_144144
Certificate reference CTHEMC_144144C
Test laboratory Hermon Laboratories Ltd.
Test period July 1–September 15, 2025
Note

The regulatory approvals and standards listed above are intended as a support reference for deployment and customer review. Confirm the latest applicable approvals for a specific market and installation environment before commercial deployment.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Quick Diagnostic Checklist

Before detailed troubleshooting, verify these basics:

  • Power supply connected and power supply LED is on
  • Both antennas properly installed (finger-tight, no wobble)
  • Gateway appears in Haltian Studio (cloud connected)
  • Firmware version is current (check for updates)
Note

The Gateway XS does not have user-visible status LEDs. All diagnostics are performed through Haltian Studio.

Gateway Not Appearing Online

Symptom: Gateway does not show as Online in Haltian Studio within 5 minutes of power-on.
